summary: Most people have one neighbor they would trust with a spare key.
realLife: About 59 percent of U.S. adults said they have a neighbor they would feel comfortable asking to keep a spare set of keys for emergencies.
sources: Pew Research Center, how connected Americans feel to neighbors (March 2025 survey): https://www.pewresearch.org/short-reads/2025/05/08/how-connected-do-americans-feel-to-their-neighbors/
inGame: neighbor tie with a trust value; needs: a favors-and-keys record on the tie

You hand over a key after a long talk over the fence.
